likely_frictions_from_similar_users: The agent clicked multiple times on elements that were not interactive, suggesting a potential confusion with the page layout or interactive elements.
what_was_easy: The agent was able to easily navigate to the 'Resources' menu and expand it.
feedback_no_reviews.product_feedback: The landing page for Freshsales CRM is visually appealing and provides a good overview of the product. However, the agent's repeated clicking on non-interactive elements suggests that the page could be clearer about what is clickable. The 'Resources' menu is comprehensive, offering a wide range of helpful information.
feedback_no_reviews.quote: I'm trying to understand how to integrate and advance the CRM system, and I'm looking for specific information on the page.

likely_frictions_from_similar_users: Some of the setup/workflows/reports can be clunky or have a bit of a learning curve to create.
When we set up the system, I don't think we accounted for certain reporting limitations based on customized fields, which has resulted in a very fragmented export / reporting process for us.
Integrations with the latest tools (GenAI in particular) can be a little lacking.
what_was_easy: The agent was able to easily navigate to the Freshsales CRM landing page.
The agent was able to open the 'Resources' menu by clicking on it.
feedback_with_reviews.product_feedback: The landing page loaded quickly and was easy to scroll through. Clicking on the 'Resources' menu was straightforward and revealed a comprehensive list of options. It's unclear from this session if the CRM system itself is easy to integrate or advance, but the initial navigation was smooth.
feedback_with_reviews.quote: I need to see how easy it is to integrate and advance the system before I can make a decision.
